# d2r-mobile-design-philosophy.md — decision principles (normative)

<!-- Generated by skill `init-dsh-project` v1.8 on 2026-10-26.
     **Normative**: when code disagrees, either the code changes or this file is amended
     through an ADR — "both are right" is not an option. -->

> Each principle answers "which of two valid approaches wins". A principle that cannot become a
> criterion is worse than none.

## P1 · Upstream-first

- **When it decides**: a HarmonyOS problem can be fixed in shared code (host, Vulkan layer,
  rewriter, Android files reused through `android_shim`) or worked around in the HarmonyOS shell.
  Fix it where it belongs, as an upstream PR; a shell workaround is acceptable only when the
  behaviour is genuinely HarmonyOS-specific.
- **What violating it looks like**: an edit to `dm/gfx/vulkan/*.c` committed on our `main`, or a
  copy of an upstream file under `dm/harmony/` with local changes — both conflict on the next sync.

## P2 · Measured on our device, or not claimed

- **When it decides**: "it works" vs "it should work". A result counts only with device model,
  firmware, API level, build (commit + version code) and the exact command / procedure.
  Upstream's numbers are quoted as upstream's.
- **What violating it looks like**: copying upstream's "59.7 fps on Mate 90 Pro Max" into our SOT
  as a baseline for the Mate X5; closing an issue because the build passed.

## P3 · One HAP for phone and PC

- **When it decides**: PC needs different behaviour. Detect it at run time — device type, window
  mode, presence of keyboard / mouse / gamepad, fold state — and switch; never fork the package
  or the source tree per device.
- **What violating it looks like**: a `pc` product in `build-profile.json5` with a different entry
  module; `#ifdef PC` in native code.

## P4 · PC is not a big phone

- **When it decides**: whether to spend effort on desktop input / windowing or to reuse the touch
  overlay on the laptop screen. On a `2in1` the default is keyboard + mouse (the PC game's
  control model, as the Mac app already does); touch stays available because the screen is a
  touch screen, and the overlay hides when no touch has happened.
- **What violating it looks like**: shipping PC support as "the phone UI stretched to 16:10"; a
  gamepad that only works after a touch.

## P5 · Saves are sacred

- **When it decides**: any install, upgrade, import or migration step that could cost the player
  their characters. Prefer refusing with a clear error over proceeding.
- **What violating it looks like**: "uninstall and reinstall" as a fix; a re-signed build with a
  new identity installed on a device with saves; an import that overwrites the sandbox save dir.

## Appendix: where these principles came from

| Principle | Origin (date + issue/ADR) | Price |
|---|---|---|
| P1 | 2026-10-26, ADR-0001 (fork with a daily-active upstream) | Every local edit to shared code is a future merge conflict |
| P2 | 2026-10-26, upstream's own HARMONYOS guide separating "install verified" from "performance accepted" | Numbers without provenance get repeated as facts |
| P3 | 2026-10-26, user goal "PC and phone", issue 001 | Two packages double signing, testing and save-migration work |
| P4 | 2026-10-26, user acceptance scope "keyboard/mouse and windows" + gamepad | — |
| P5 | Upstream HARMONYOS guide ("do not uninstall an app with saves") | Lost characters are unrecoverable |
